messages:
maria_sales: Kicking off VanguardAI POC — they want sustained 150-200 QPS for chat completions (avg ~350 tokens, occasional up to 1024). Need a perf runbook + answers for their security questionnaire (KMS/HSM, logs, rotation). @kevin_eng can you own the perf plan? @julie_security can you take the SQ items? cc @ashley_sre for ops/runbook.

kevin_eng: Yep — quick clarifying Qs: is this single-turn completions only, or multi-turn chat with KV cache reuse? Also confirm SLO targets (p95/p99). Any constraints on batching?

maria_sales: Single-turn mostly, but they may do some 2-3 turn threads. SLOs: p95 <= 400ms, p99 <= 800ms. They can accept bursts to 250 QPS for short windows. Client allows batching of up to 4.

kevin_eng: Plan: 1) smoke (5m) at 50 QPS, 2) soak (30m) at 150 QPS, 3) spike/stress sweep up to 300 QPS with 1m spikes. Run in us-east1 first, then multi-AZ if we need failover tests. Warmup + KV prefill required to avoid cold-start tails. Proposed loadgen command:

```
# example loadgen invocation
loadgen --model redwood-7b-instruct-q4 --target-qps 150 --duration 30m --concurrency 50 --avg-tokens 350 --max-tokens 1024
```

kevin_eng: I'll capture p50/p95/p99, error rate, and token cost delta. Will also collect per-token latency heatmap and kernel metrics.

ashley_sre: Heads-up: Dedicated pools need ~20m warm-up after deploy to populate KV caches. If you want low p99 we should prefill common prefixes — I can provide a small script to POST a set of warmup prompts before the soak. Also ensure autoscaler min instances cover sustained 200 QPS to avoid scale-up blips.

julie_security: For the SQ items: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) for private & dedicated. HSM-backed keys available in Private deployments; Dedicated supports envelope encryption + CMK integration. Audit logs can be streamed to customer S3/GCS and retained per contract. Key rotation: we support automatic rotation + manual rewrap; we provide rotation attestations and can share SOC2/ISO artifacts under NDA. I'll draft concise answers for their questionnaire. Link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/kms-hsm (internal).

maria_sales: Great. Timeline: can we deliver the perf run + SQ draft by EOD tomorrow? Prospect wants preliminary numbers for their internal comms.

kevin_eng: We can run the first soak today (I'll start in ~30m) and push results by EOD. If p99 is >800ms we'll iterate with batching/quantize tweaks.

deploy-bot: loadgen-runner: test-run-1733333350 completed — 30m soak at 150 QPS in us-east1. Results: p50 95ms, p95 320ms, p99 780ms, error rate 0.18%, avg tokens 352, peak CPU kernel sat 72%. Attach logs: /internal/artifacts/1733333350 (ops only).

kevin_eng: Nice baseline. p99 at 780ms is within their target but close. Next steps: enable prefix cache prefill and try batch_size=2 -> should shave ~80-120ms off p99 in our tests. Will also test q4_0 quantization path for cost/latency tradeoff.

maria_sales: I'll package the baseline numbers and the SQ draft for VanguardAI. FYI they flagged a blocker: they need HSM in Dedicated (not only Private). Julie — can we confirm roadmap or workaround (e.g., customer-side HSM + envelope keys)?

julie_security: Confirmed: HSM-attested keys are currently supported in Private. For Dedicated we can propose envelope encryption with customer-managed CMK in KMS; some customers run an external HSM + bring-your-own-key pattern. I'll outline both options in the SQ reply and note timelines for expanding HSM support.

ashley_sre: Noted the blocker. Ops can run a multi-region failover test next Tue to demonstrate resilience; also will add autoscaler sanity checks to runbook.

maria_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll circulate a short digest to VanguardAI with the baseline numbers, runbook highlights, and the security Q responses. Targeting EOD tomorrow. :tada:
